_comment: A waiver suppresses a violation that is already owned by another in-flight PR.
Every waiver MUST name an owner. Waivers are self-expiring: once the owning PR
lands and the violation disappears, the check reports the waiver as 'stale-waiver'
and fails CI until the entry is deleted. That is deliberate -- a waiver cannot rot
Do NOT add a waiver to make a real violation disappear. Fix the gate.

waivers.reason: The only occurrence of orderBy('ads.is_catalog_filler', 'asc') is inside AdController::index(), which no route or caller reaches (GET /ads -> AdIndexController@index). PR #1131 already deletes that line, moves the ranking rule into App\Support\CatalogInventoryRanking, retargets this guard to the routed controller, and adds backend/tests/Feature/CatalogRealInventoryRankingTest.php. Editing the same assertion here would collide with #1131, so this waiver is reported rather than fixed. It expires automatically when #1131 merges.
